resources.string: Download the model, then chat runs entirely on this device
First setup needs a one-time network download (~1.5 GB) from Hugging Face — no account required.
After download, inference is 100% offline — prompts and outputs never leave the device.
Runtime supports arm64-v8a / x86_64 only; ~6 GB RAM recommended. On weaker devices the model loads slowly or fails.
1.5B-parameter quantized models: fast and private, but not cloud-scale assistants. Treat their output accordingly.
This device\'s CPU is not supported by the LiteRT-LM runtime (arm64 / x86_64 only).
Device memory is below the model\'s 6 GB recommendation — loading may fail.
Both listed models download without an HF account; smaller models (Gemma3-1B) are gated repos and therefore not included.
